==About==

A {{i|Roasted Darkwater Bluegill}} is obtained when crafting {{i|Roasted Fish}} using a {{i|Filet of Darkwater Bluegill}} over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
